rows.text: Looks like you're no longer that surprised to see me, even though I am an uninvited guest.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Looks like you're no longer that surprised to see me, even though I am an uninvited guest.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: You used memoria to resist me, but did you not consider the possibility that...
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: The Remembrance and THEIR children might have taken this opportunity to join the fray as well?
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: Are you saying the Garden of Recollection is also getting involved in this unsavory mess?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Then I welcome them. If the Memokeepers can disrupt your little experiment of Destruction, I'll give them a standing ovation.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: But you know deep down that they can't. In fact, the Memosnatchers will be more of a hindrance to you.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: The Memokeepers covet Amphoreus's secrets, just as they covet the knowledge of every genius. In the war between the Aeons, the Remembrance is never the Erudition's ally.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: Heh... It's just like what she predicted. The truth shook you, just like she said it would.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Heh... It's just like what she predicted. The truth shook you, just like she said it would.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: But THEY are certainly not an ally of the Destruction either.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Right now, following behind the Trailblaze, numerous cosmic powers have cast their sights on Amphoreus. They all have vastly different philosophies, but the desire to survive will unite them against a common enemy.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: How can you be certain that these powers don't have their own end goals, waiting to seize an advantage in the "war among the Aeons"?
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: The war has long begun, Screwllum. Four Paths will push the cosmos to its end, and the Destruction is only one of them.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: Polka saw these ripples but had no way of stopping them, so she founded Device IX. Dr. Primitive also took action, but he chose the wrong allies, and now only wild animals keep him company. As for the two inorganic emperors...
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: They could have ascended to the throne of Destruction, but they were thwarted by the Aeons' plots and became prisoners of the Erudition instead. What's interesting is, while the second emperor had a body made of flesh and blood, he considered himself an inorganic being. Guess who was the one who influenced his thinking?
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: We have no interest in chatting about the past with you. Logic: You are stalling, which means you feel trapped.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Of course. You've got to be at the same level as a genius if you want to contend with them.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Hehe, "trapped." Yes, looking back, when "Zandar" was a human, he often felt trapped.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: But patience became my strongest weapon because of this. I've always waited for so long. What's a bit more waiting?
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: You don't want to test the resolve of a dead man who's crossed thousands of Amber Eras.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: Of course. You've got to be at the same level as a genius if you want to contend with them.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: ...You're right. We won't get anywhere the way things are going right now.
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: Every member of the Society has their own way of thinking, and we were never going to "expand" your thinking through words. Since we've reached an impasse in this debate...
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: It's my turn now, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Anaxagoras?
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: ...Ah. I see.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: Exactly. The benefit of dealing with intelligent individuals is that there's no need to waste words. The answer is exactly as you think—
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Loop Hysilens in. Let her join the final act. I'll transmute myself into a Philosopher's Stone and embed myself into the formula...
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: And when the time comes, she needs to shatter me and scatter that stone's ashes into the ocean within the Vortex.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: So what exactly does your formula do?
rows.speaker: Cipher

rows.text: Now that would spoil the climax, wouldn't it?
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: I thought no one would notice me if I just waited at a corner of the Memory Zone...
But I see that wasn't enough to fool you, my dear [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Aww, that look... so full of memories... But... I'm not "her."
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: I wouldn't do that. Ever.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Only you can see me right now. I only exist in your cognition, so that way, other people can't interrupt us.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: You mean, what's going on with "March 7th."
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Good. I like people who don't beat around the bush, so let's talk about the one thing you should know...
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: She's... nowhere.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: It looks like you still aren't prepared for the worst, hmm.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Time's ticking, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Why don't you just listen to the one thing you should know instead of getting distracted by the details?
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Your friend "March 7th" is no more.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Yep. No more.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: "March 7th" entered this world long before you and Dan Heng arrived at Amphoreus.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: She embraced the Path of Remembrance to save you two and burned away, like a lone candle in the fog.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: And I... am the shadow cast by her candlelight.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: I've been hiding within the cracks of Time all these years. It isn't easy to deceive a genius, but I can do it.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: I have ten thousand ways to torture an Antikytheran, and in the Flame-Chase Journey that [Trailblazer] experienced, the previous me already discovered the optimal solution.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Just as that Titan made themself at home in my brain, I can also fuse myself with your avatar through alchemy. I didn't know until I tried it, but this is simply brilliant! I can flip through a genius's data bank like reading a book...
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: Then, I will step onto the stage at the perfect moment and use the truth to end this long debate.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: And just as always, I'll leave the audience speechless.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: ...You waited in the data stream for hundreds of years?
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: This universe is worth all that time that I invested.
rows.speaker: Anaxa

rows.text: How absurd, but I can't help but admire it. You managed to avoid the watchful eye of the Erudition and plan all of this within Amphoreus. It seems that there was a slight oversight in my assessment of the experiment...
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: Oh. Perhaps there was more than just one oversight.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: "More than just one"?
rows.speaker: Herta

rows.text: I underestimated the Remembrance's methods. A third party is about to join our discussion.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: Still haven't noticed it?
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: In the past few moments, we've all forgotten something, haven't we?
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: Miss Cyrene disappeared.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: I'll now answer your other question about who returned the Coreflame of Time in this cycle.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: The answer is simple.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: I've missed you so much, March 7th...
No one ever did.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Did you steal my memories?
I believe someone as sharp as [Trailblazer] would definitely figure out that something's wrong.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: When the Era Nova fails to proceed, you will remember our initial meeting, and I'll be able to open the way for the Remembrance and reach this place.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Thank you for carrying this Coreflame all the way to the end of the world. I expected nothing less from "March 7th's" trusted friend. And now...
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: I shall claim the divine authority of Time.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: There's not much in this universe that I care about, except "March 7th" and her cherished companions.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: I already told you. She no longer exists. But you still have a chance to fix everything.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: The divine authority isn't actually all that important. What's important is that I will use it to participate in the inner workings of this world.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: You already have a good idea of what the Era Nova does, right? It initiates extrapolations for the next cycle based on the Worldbearer's "memories."
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: This immutable experimental mechanism is the key to the geniuses' resistance against Irontomb. And now... I'll be lending it just a touch more help.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Let me filter your memories, keep the appropriate seeds, and discard the rest. That way... We'll be able to complete an Era Nova that this world has never before seen.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: It won't take too long. You just need to step into the Rain of Sensation with me. I'll tell you who deserves to be forgotten... and who deserves to be remembered.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: With your "memories" as the base material, I will re-create the cause and effect of this world, and let a flawless "Amphoreus" be born from the chaos!
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Isn't the fate of the entire cosmos hinged upon this fight? Then this is the best way to ensure everything works out. It will most certainly defeat the Destruction while composing an unforgettable chapter for the Trailblaze.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: I'm not surprised at your answer. But I don't need your trust right now.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Mere mortals. Flawed individuals. Failed heroes... People like them cannot nurture the world and would only become "memory" impurities.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Yet "being forgotten" is the normal state of life. The universe is like a wasteland filled with rubbish, where occasional treasures lie undiscovered.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: You're right. I'm not "her," but our hearts are closely intertwined.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: "[Trailblazer], what's going on? Your consciousness... suddenly went so far away."
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I promise you that the Astral Express Crew will definitely see each other again in that new world.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Besides, that's what March 7th wanted.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Besides, that's what March 7th wanted.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Besides, that's what March 7th wanted.

rows.text: Besides, that's what March 7th wanted.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: "March 7th" made a wish to me before she disappeared. Her only wish... was for the Trailblaze's journey to continue without an end.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: I'll definitely fulfil that small wish for her.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: So, come, [Trailblazer]. Sink into the sea of "Oblivion" and become my guest.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: So much time, just the two of us. And guess what? You cannot refuse my invitation.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Because this memoria tide comes from your companion... "March 7th"...
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: It's her deepest and innermost "memory."
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Well, I'm not actually all that surprised. I saw you ages ago, after all.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: It was on that night when a certain Knight of Beauty dropped by uninvited to the Astral Express...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Heh. I see.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: ...That was when you showed up without even saying anything.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Then, do you still remember how long it has been since you entered Amphoreus?
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: That's... gonna be tough to answer...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: 97 days.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: You walked every inch of this world in 97 days, but unfortunately...
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: ...No one was able to see you, and you weren't able to interact with anyone.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: Like how the Memokeepers renounce their flesh and turn into memetic entities, you are now a ghost... a being unperceived by all.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: But I can't just do nothing. This world... is super terrifying.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: [Trailblazer] and Dan Heng have already set off. The Astral Express could appear on the horizon any second now...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: And they, too, will become this place's victims.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: For ages, I've watched people walk through that door. They couldn't see or hear my calls. The voices beyond always promised safety, but I've never seen anyone return safely...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: They are all humans who got lured into this place...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: But these people's "memories" were tampered with. That's not what happened with the Express Crew.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: That's so cruel... Did the Memosnatchers do that?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I don't know. I only possess "your" memories.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: None of these people managed to break through {RUBY_B#firewall}the Sky's seal{RUBY_E#}. There's probably a dangerous reason as to why Amphoreus had remained undiscovered for so long.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: Anyway. Back to our initial topic.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You gotta know something, right? We practically look like twins! Maybe you know a thing or two about my past? Or... any hidden powers I might have?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...Please. Tell me what I need to do to protect [Trailblazer] and Dan Heng.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Have you ever wondered what the word "cost" means before jumping into action?
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: "Cost"...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Shouldn't I be the one asking you that?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: You always hid in my memories... never wanted to come out. The only times you showed yourself were when I got into serious trouble.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's because you also don't wanna get discovered by the Garden's observers. Am I wrong?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: There's no one here except us. If you help me, then I'll help you.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: ...Fine. Let me drop a single pebble into these stagnant waters and watch the ripples reshape everything.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: But you must polish this "pebble" with your own hands, and it will require all of "your" memories.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: ...What will I turn into after that?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Maybe you'll turn into a guiding light, or maybe you'll be reduced to dead embers. I can't guarantee that you'll remain the "person" you are now.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: Inside you is nothing but an "evernight." Even I can only catch a tiny glimpse of it.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: If this is the only way, then I don't see why I should say no. Besides...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: The mastermind behind the show is about to find us.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: "Apologies, lost young lady, but I simply cannot allow you to keep acting as you please."
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: So he can't see you, huh? As expected.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Or maybe, he's seen through our true essence.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: "The Garden of Recollection's methods are puny party tricks, but you... How did you overcome the Ultimate Protocol?"
rows.speaker: Lygus

rows.text: Looks like we don't have time to keep talking this out...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: That's right. Some opportunities will never come again.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: Then let's do it. Offer up all of "my" memories...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Cast down this pebble, and let everything in this world...
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: Be swallowed by the torrents of "Oblivion."
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: It's unusually quiet here...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: March 7th isn't here...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: We should trust March 7th and Cyrene.
Yes, but we can't let our guard down.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: We absolutely can't let our guard down.
Yes. Let's trust March 7th and Cyrene.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Let's go find them.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You were the one who protected us...
You saved us, March.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Evernight... she's gone?
She... has returned to her slumber in the evernight.
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Don't cry, or I'll have to start telling jokes.
How can I possibly hold back my tears at a time like this!?
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I had so many ideas for our reunion. I was gonna sneak up from behind you when you weren't looking, tap you both on the shoulder, then flick you each on the head...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: One way or another, we will always find our way back to each other.
Stop being so serious...!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: But... we were here first... *sniff*...
Y—you too!? If this keeps up... I... I won't be able to stop crying!
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: I'm... I'm just so happy...
rows.speaker: March 7th

rows.text: Is this... the Parlor Car?

rows.text: Am I back already? But why don't I remember anything about my journey back?

rows.text: (Something doesn't feel right...)
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: (Think back to when [Trailblazer] and I separated...)
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It will take time to uncover the reason. Before then, if one of the Nameless is willing to stay and witness the fate of this world — or to push it along when necessary — it would be of great assistance.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: This is goodbye then, Lord Dan Heng.
rows.speaker: Zeph the Guard

rows.text: Thank you, guard. I hope that all of you will be able to... overcome this disaster.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...But I can't remember anything after that, no matter how hard I think.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: "He stayed with Madam Herta. They wanted to try using his 'tuning' to help support the geniuses' thought hacking."
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Is that Himeko's voice? And Mr. Yang...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "Oh my... That was Herta's suggestion? It's hard to imagine she'd borrow the power of the Harmony."
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: "No, it was Sunday's suggestion. Herta initially refused."
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: "But she changed her mind after Zandar's identity was revealed."
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: "And we still can't get in contact with the Xianzhou Luofu?"
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: "I'm still trying, but this place is outside the Interastral Peace Communications' coverage zone, so there's a limit to what we can do."
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: "What about... Aventurine's chip? The mini transmitter. Surely it can get through to the IPC's lines."
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: "Himeko, are you alright? I've never seen you this anxious before."
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: "I'm... alright. I'm probably just tired. Let's focus our energy on the kids. Now's not the time for distractions."
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: "Right... unfortunately, I left that chip in the Dreamscape when we departed Penacony."
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Am I... dreaming?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: No way! [Trailblazer] will definitely be snapping away all over Amphoreus because {F#s}he promised me to take photos! I'm guaranteed to run into {M#him}{F#her} eventually.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: True, you really know {M#him}{F#her} well.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: The Parlor Car feels... so strange.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Are the voices coming from the Passenger Cabin?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "Passengers [Trailblazer] and Dan Heng have to return safely..."
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: "...Don't worry, Pom-Pom. They're both experienced Nameless. They'll be just fine."
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I'm right here. But where did all of you go?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: (I always thought this little corner felt odd. [Trailblazer] often got lost in thought here too...)
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "Memory of Chaos, here I come..."
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (But now that oddness has spread to every corner of the train.)
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "It's hard to believe that their Car is still floating in the vacuum of space..."
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: "That's why the Express wasn't able to receive any landing signal."
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: So when {F#s}he told Cyrene in this cycle about {M#his}{F#her} interstellar travels, those memories of journeying with the Express entered my mind as well...
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: "It's likely that the two missing Nameless, like March 7th, also came under the influence of the Path of Remembrance, and only their minds entered Amphoreus."
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...Hah.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: "We can analyze all we want, but the real question is: What can we do right now?"
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: "I was just about to get there, Miss Himeko. Right now, Amphoreus's Memory Zone is extraordinarily full..."
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: "I can also take this opportunity to enter the world and seize as much of an advantage for the Astral Express as possible before the other Memokeepers arrive."
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: "For example, I can light a beacon in the Memory Zone for [Trailblazer] and Dan Heng to follow back home."
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: March's room... I haven't heard a single peep from her this whole time.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: March already wasn't feeling very well when [Trailblazer] and I set out. Even if this is a dream, I should still check on her.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...No, that's not polite.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: March, it's me.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...Well, there's no other choice.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Gently push open the door.
Sorry, March.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This isn't a dream after all...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "Based on what Madam Herta said, Dan Heng should already be on his way back..."
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: "But the Express hasn't detected any traces of him."
