rows.text: I feel like I've seen these floating black things somewhere before...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "Or he's already returned to the Express."
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: "But fell into the trap of someone with ulterior motives."
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: No, I've definitely seen them before...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: But I've lost that memory.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Hah...
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: The Memokeepers' memetic entities are truly everywhere.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "Don't worry. Normal Memokeepers can't do anything to that little dragon. As long as he's awake enough, he'll find a way out."
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: "All he needs is a little concentration, patience, and resolve."
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: "Hearing you say that makes me feel much better. Dan Heng..."
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: "Has all of the qualities you mentioned."
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: I don't know what your intentions are.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: But as the guard of the Astral Express, I must ask...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Any suspicious and uninvited guests to leave!
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Is the trap now taken care of?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...Dan Heng!
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Miss Himeko, I'm back.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Even if it's just through a "spirit warp jump"...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You could hear our conversations?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Yes. It was thanks to your voices that I could pierce through the memoria barrier. Although...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It was not a wise decision to let a Memokeeper of unknown origins board the Express.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Can't argue with that.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Miss Black Swan has been on the Crew's side ever since things started going wrong in Amphoreus. We can trust her.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: So many baffling things kept happening one after another, I don't even know where to begin. I wish I could've returned with better news...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Don't blame yourself. You're all safe and sound, and that's good enough for me.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Are [Trailblazer] and March 7th really safe and sound?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: As a matter of fact, while you were on your way back, Amphoreus's circumstances changed once again.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: And these circumstances have something to do with the two you just mentioned.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Are you saying that [Trailblazer] has been kidnapped by an unidentified Remembrance pathstrider?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: So you're saying that person's appearance is identical to March 7th?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: It's too early to say that as I haven't seen her with my own eyes. I've only detected a similar aura in the Memory Zone.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: We have no way of knowing what March 7th has experienced. But I can assure you, if we sink too far into the memoria tide of that "Miss March"...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: What will happen?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: 33,550,336th eternal recurrence, Light Calendar 4932...
Sometime before the campaign against Aquila...
Everyone here will be torn to pieces.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Please trust me on this.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: ...But I also trust in our Trailblazing companions. I know this isn't what March would want.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: No matter what secrets are buried within, we'll do whatever we can to find that "March 7th," and bring back [Trailblazer] and the March we all know.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I mostly understand what we've learned about the Erudition and the Destruction, but what roles do the Remembrance's intruders play in Amphoreus?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I made some new discoveries related to that with Madam Herta's help.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: As part of the deal, do you mind if I share them with you?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Alright then... Fourth Mirror?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: It's finally my turn to shine? Ooh, this feels like such a grand occasion!
rows.speaker: Fourth Mirror

rows.text: Their projections are in the Parlor Car!
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Welt, and Mr. Screwllum.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Himeko, you seem to be feeling much better now.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: And Dan Heng, it's great to be able to talk to you. Once again, we owe Madam Herta a huge favor.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Madam Herta doesn't care much for favors, but she'll be happy to receive everyone's praise.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: The two of you were very fortunate as there was something protecting your bodies. All vital signs are still present, and your functions are all intact.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Was it... March protecting us?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Our preliminary determination is that the "bubble" enveloping you two in the vacuum is made of a substance similar to memoria. Conjecture: This substance is connected to the lost Miss March.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: It will take some effort to bring your bodies back to the Express, so you should get some rest first.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Have we completely lost contact with the inside of Amphoreus?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: There have been several unforeseen circumstances. We broke through Lygus's firewall after the "Law" was amended...
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: But now Amphoreus is enveloped by the fierce Path of Remembrance, once again cutting off all channels of communication for outsiders.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: So we have no way of contacting [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Dan Heng... What are you thinking?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: If it was March who helped us get past the firewall initially...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Then does that mean only [Trailblazer] and I have the "travel permit" for Amphoreus right now?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: That is a logical inference, Mr. Dan Heng.
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: Mr. Screwllum, do you have a way to transmit my spirit signal back to Amphoreus?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You want to go back? That is... far too risky.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Even if my body and spirit are able to return without a hitch, there's not much I can do here.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: We can't lose you again, Dan Heng.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Miss Himeko, if we can't get [Trailblazer] and March back...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: How is that any different from losing me?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You're right. I should've known you'd say something like that.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Hah... I suppose there's no point in trying to dissuade you.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: Mr. Yang, Miss Himeko, I will do everything in my power to bring the Express Crew back together—
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: No one will be left behind.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: (March... When did she leave this here? I didn't hear a thing...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...Who's there?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Is this The Reverie Hotel?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Seriously, what is happening...?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: [Trailblazer], there you are! What took you so long?
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Hurry up, the navigation meeting is about to start.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: (Navigation meeting... in Penacony?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Come on over, [Trailblazer]. It's time to choose our next destination.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Perfect timing. The meeting's hit a standstill: Lushaka or Melustanin, no one can make the call.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: Hah...
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: The vote's split two against two. Everything hinges on your vote now.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: What do you mean?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: And once again, passenger [Trailblazer] is talking nonsense.
rows.speaker: Pom-Pom

rows.text: Ah, young people. Always full of jokes.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: (What...? Their reactions... What's going on?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Ah, I get it, [Trailblazer] wants to play a game with us, right?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You said you didn't see March.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: True, she might be hiding somewhere in the lobby.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: The objective of the game... is to uncover where she's hiding.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: You're her closest companion. If anyone can do it, it's you, right?
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: (Is March 7th... playing hide-and-seek with me?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Youthful games like this are a bit much for me these days. I'll step aside and let you all take the spotlight. The future belongs to you now.
rows.speaker: Welt

rows.text: (Something about Mr. Yang's attitude feels... a little off.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (No idea what {F#s}he was always muttering about.)
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You seem in good spirits, [Trailblazer]. Rest assured. Wherever our next stop is, I'll make sure you're all protected.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: (Huh... Dan Heng, being this forward? That's not like him at all.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Not feeling ready yet? How about a cup of my special coffee blend to calm your nerves? Everyone says great things about it.
rows.speaker: Himeko

rows.text: (Wait, everyone is saying great things about Himeko's coffee? Yeah, sure... lying liars.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Knock gently.
Barge in.
(March 7th isn't here...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Knock gently.
(Faint, fleeting voices are speaking to me... but where are they coming from?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: No answer.
(I went through something like this before, back in Penacony...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Not even Lygus's prison could hold me... I found my way out.)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Keep it together. I know I can do this...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Listen to the music of the Harmony.
Capture that streak of "pink."
Completely give in.
"I found you, [Trailblazer]. You did well."
rows.speaker: Distant Male Voice

rows.text: "Soar! Break free from the cage of memoria. Let harmony become your wings..."
rows.speaker: Distant Male Voice

rows.text: "A clever little trick. But stealing a fledgling from someone else's nest..."
rows.speaker: Evernight

rows.text: "Not exactly the pinnacle of integrity, is it ♭"
rows.speaker: Evernight

rows.text: "Well done, [Trailblazer]... just like that time in the sea of flowers in the nether realm."
rows.speaker: "Pink" Voice

rows.text: "Snatch up my colors, okay? Then we can go home together!"
rows.speaker: "Pink" Voice

rows.text: "You... you're trying to tamper with the Remembrance too..."
rows.speaker: Evernight

rows.text: "Too bad~ You're no match for me ♭"
rows.speaker: Evernight

rows.text: "No matter what, don't give up, [Trailblazer]..."
rows.speaker: Distant Male Voice

rows.text: "[Trailblazer], take my hand!"
rows.speaker: "Pink" Voice

rows.text: "The Harmony and the Remembrance..."
rows.speaker: Evernight

rows.text: "My, what a fascinating partnership you two have formed ♭"
rows.speaker: Evernight

rows.text: Did you find her, [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: "Dan Heng"

rows.text: No. It's a futile game, isn't it?
rows.speaker: "Himeko"

rows.text: In truth, you don't have to go to such lengths to find March 7th.
rows.speaker: "Welt"

rows.text: Because in this Memory Zone, March is everywhere.
rows.speaker: "Pom-Pom"

rows.text: We're protecting March 7th's wish, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: You... you seriously can't sense it?
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: She doesn't want to say goodbye to the Trailblaze. She wants to keep traveling together... forever and ever...
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: We are her memosprites. For the sake of her wish... we must give it our all.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Finally, the timing is just right...
A thrilling "damsel-in-distress rescue"!
Wait... maybe I got that backwards?
It's me, Cyrene! But now I'm in... my "Mem" form!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: That's right, but now I'm in... my "Mem" form!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Seriously! One mysterious and cute memosprite is more than enough!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: [Trailblazer], come with me... We're getting out of here.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Me too! But first things first, let's ditch these memosprites.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: If it really bothers [Trailblazer] that much, I'll close my eyes. Just take my hand and lead the way!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Where am I...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The space station. Where it all began for [Trailblazer]. Looks like... we made it.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Mmm? What's that?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Silver Wolf... Kafka!?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Ah, it's [Trailblazer]'s secret! I'm so curious... but I won't peek. Promise!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: When I first met [Trailblazer], I remember they were there in your memories too.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Yes. This memory is all too real... and so, so heavy.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: [Trailblazer] sounds really nostalgic...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Want to take a closer look, [Trailblazer]? Go ahead, think of it as a glimpse into the past.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: I'll stay right here. I promise not to disturb you.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Hard to say... Maybe a few more minutes?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: By the way... "that part" in the script — could this be the right moment?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Yes, looks like we're on the same page. In that case...
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Listen.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Remember these words... then forget them. Let them slumber in the depths of your memory, until the day they are awakened once more.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: On that day, your journey will intertwine with the Remembrance. In nearly every possibility Elio has foreseen, it leads to a great crisis. You'll face betrayal, lose your way... and seek answers.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: So... before you hear these words...
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: I don't want you to consider this a prophecy. You arrived at this moment because of the decisions you made.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Hmm?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: I don't know what you'll have endured... or whether you'll still believe in me. But if there's even a trace of doubt in your heart... I hope these words can give you strength...
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: It was a wish of the cosmos that set you in motion. And in the tale where you are the protagonist, the stars themselves will defy the destiny of "Finality."
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Mark this number: "four." According to Terminus's prophecy, four Paths will push the cosmos to its end. And on your journey, you shall encounter THEM... one by one.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: "Destruction."
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: "Harmony."
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: "Nihility."
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Easy now. Trust what you remember. The fourth Path has yet to fully reveal THEIR face.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: And that's why the journey's worth it. Even in a predetermined "script," there's room for us to mold possibilities into shapes we prefer.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: So listen: Take this guiding principle... then forget it. Let your own will be what expands your journey through life.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: As in the past, even while achieving so much, you never let go of your pursuit of freedom.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: That was so sincere... I might actually tear up a little.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: We all live within the "script." But adding a little color to the lines... has never been forbidden.
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Are you going to say more about those branching storylines?
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Black Swan told Dan Heng what happened to [Trailblazer]...
If that's the case, then there's nothing to fear. Collect yourself and go find Cyrene.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: All things considered, that's the most reasonable conclusion. It's a lot to take in. Time to clear my head and find Cyrene again.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: The pressure's really starting to build... I can barely think straight. I need to clear my head and go find Cyrene.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Cy...rene...?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: "Oh, Triple-Faced Soul..."
...This stage really brings back memories.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: "Yes, [Trailblazer]..."
"For you... I suppose it's been a long time, hasn't it?"
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "None of this would've been possible without Miss Cyrene. Even while engulfed by memoria, she fought to stay in contact with the geniuses."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Only then, through 'tuning', was I able to undo the Memory Zone's effect on you."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "What's the matter? Your expression is one full of hesitation..."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Step onto the stage first. 'Miss March' will come for us soon, and she won't be alone. Those memosprites will follow. We need to prepare early. Only then can we get you out safely, and go back for Cyrene and March 7th."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Please, be careful. Amphoreus is being overwhelmed by an unusually violent memoria tide. I'll do all I can... but even that might not be enough."
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Lift the curtain of memory—"
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: "—and stir up ripples of past reverie!"
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Even so, I must think long-term.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I wanted to hide in the shadows to avoid direct conflict, but...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Why is it so quiet here?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Back to the topic at hand... Mr. Dan Heng, we did a sweep of the area surrounding Amphoreus's celestial body for organic signals, and we finally discovered the bodies of you and {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Screwllum

rows.text: The air is thick with memoria, yet it's so chaotic, like broken memories all mixed together.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Memosnatchers should be swarming into Amphoreus. I was expecting this place to be "very lively"...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: So... how did they end up like this?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Now, I'm getting very... curious.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I keep getting the feeling that the same thing happened in Penacony.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: What a... bizarre sight.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: "It's spinning out of control... Everything's out of control..."
rows.speaker: Terrified Memosnatcher

rows.text: "Why did no one tell us!?"
rows.speaker: Terrified Memosnatcher

rows.text: If we take into account the difference in the flow of time, every minute we delay here could be a year of waiting for {M#him...}{F#her...}
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "That girl... is the Memokeepers' nemesis..."
rows.speaker: Terrified Memosnatcher

rows.text: Is she talking about March 7th?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: "That evernight... Those black memosprites... They swallowed everything..."
rows.speaker: Terrified Memosnatcher

rows.text: "Those who came here first... all drowned... Not even a trace of their consciousness was left behind..."
rows.speaker: Terrified Memosnatcher

rows.text: "I wish I'd never come here... I don't want anything to do with Amphoreus anymore! Please! I'm begging you!"
rows.speaker: Terrified Memosnatcher

rows.text: "D—Don't come near me— N—Nooo!"
rows.speaker: Terrified Memosnatcher

rows.text: You've involved too many innocent people just to obtain the "Memory of an Aeon's Fall." You deserve this.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: But I'm not here to blame you.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: That entity you call "Evernight"... Tell me everything you know about her.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: We may yet bring a glimmer of hope for those who are still alive in there.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: "Eden... of Blessed Insight..."
rows.speaker: Terrified Memosnatcher

rows.text: Huh...?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: "So that's. What happened. We. Were tricked."
rows.speaker: Terrified Memosnatcher

rows.text: "We. Are the sacrifice. The Garden. Used us. The 'Pure Child of Anāsrava.' Abandoned us."
rows.speaker: Terrified Memosnatcher

rows.text: "She just. Wants to find. Her lost sisters."
rows.speaker: Terrified Memosnatcher

rows.text: "Find them. Kill them. Reclaim them."
rows.speaker: Terrified Memosnatcher

rows.text: "If a new life is to be born. Its seed has to be dead."
rows.speaker: Terrified Memosnatcher

rows.text: "Dead. Dead. Dead. Dead."
rows.speaker: Terrified Memosnatcher

rows.text: "Dead dead dead dead dead dead dead dead dead dead dead dead—"
rows.speaker: Terrified Memosnatcher

rows.text: Heh. I can finally understand your fears now.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: "Keep it down... I think I've found {M#him."}{F#her."}
rows.speaker: Distant Male Voice

rows.text: Thank you for the information. It was... very valuable.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I'll take your remaining consciousness out of here as a gesture of thanks.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: It'll serve as both protection and a punishment. You'll reunite with your peers in a genius's mirror, where you can reflect long and hard on your past actions.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Well... provided that—
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I can survive my encounter with her.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: You created this wasteland before us with your own hands.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Such sights are no longer able to stir anything in my heart.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: Are you saying that, once upon a time, you were actually moved by their defiance?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I'm sorry to say, I never was.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: ...Hmm?
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: I didn't think there were still some that got away.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: Explain.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: They are thieves from the Garden. They have long coveted this world, but had always been kept out.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: They finally got a chance thanks to your "efforts." Unfortunately, they ran into "Miss March" and their consciousnesses were plucked out one by one, reducing them to mere husks.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: Those who were lucky enough to escape her drowned in the black tide, becoming these twisted figures.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: But they look very different from the usual Black Tide Creatures.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The reason has to do with our destination.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: Let us deal with the threats before us first. Then, I'll reveal the answer to you.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: You really have no intention of fighting, do you?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Hehe. I have no grounds to assist you.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: Besides, the geniuses are still keeping a close eye on me. I would hate for anything I do to be misconstrued as provocation against you.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: ...Never mind. Let me clear the way.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What splendid spearmanship. Truly remarkable.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: Let's get back on our previous topic.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: These Memosnatchers attempted to infiltrate the breeding ground of the black tide to steal Irontomb's memories.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: That sounds like a surefire way of destroying themselves.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Well, our views differ on that. They had a chance to reach the truth precisely because they did not fear death.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: That futile worldbearer turned himself into a seal in this cycle, attempting to suppress the black tide's spread.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: His golden blood soaked into the ocean tides and covered the earth, etching the scar of Destruction into this world.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: And that scar... shall point the way forward for you.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: Erudition, Destruction, Remembrance...
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: When the Three Paths cross once again, Amphoreus shall face a most magnificent end.
rows.speaker: "Zandar"

rows.text: The Grove...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Even the branches and leaves of the sacred tree have been dyed gold. Phainon gave his all for [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Seems like we're one person short.
Now that the Destruction has quelled the memoria tide, it's time for me to go deeper into the Grove.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...Awoo!
rows.speaker: Flustered Chimera

rows.text: Who's there!?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: That fiery blaze engulfed the Grove and woke all creatures from their slumber...
What game?
And you, visitor from beyond the sky... You have no intention of listening to the cries of the "Earth."
You are...?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Are you surprised? Demigods with golden blood are not solely limited to {RUBY_B#humans}Kephale's children{RUBY_E#}. Is it not natural that the offspring of Georios would take on their duty?
I am Terravox, avatar of the earth, divine protector of the myriad living beings.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: What a coincidence. I was just told by someone to watch out for you.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Listen carefully...
Answer me: Why would the Dromas King of the legends, the demigod who should have fallen, appear in humanoid form?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You already know the answer: Is the Transmutation Arcanum not precisely your specialty, descendant of the Permanence?
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: How do you know about...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Was it "March 7th"?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Exactly. Thanks to her, I was able to escape into the memoria tide and disappear from the world's memories.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: So you didn't die. Your "fall" was just a lie. You cast aside your duty as a Flame-Chaser and joined her. Why?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: To survive. For a dromas, life is no more than "existence"...
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: The birds and beasts of this world have struggled to survive since time immemorial. Yet, unlike humans, they are unable to live on in the Worldbearer's memories.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: But Evernight is the master of Remembrance, and I saw your story in the Veil of Evernight—
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: █ ██ █Vidyadhara █ ██ the Permanence █ dragon transmutation ██ █ █resurrec █tion█ ████ █
rows.speaker: Ichor Memosprite

rows.text: The path you chose to survive will lead to your death, demigod.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: And what of it? This body is soaked in filthy golden blood...
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: The "Earth" is hungry, and only the Permanence can satisfy it!
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: Is this some... disordered memory?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...Ugh!
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The mists of the past shall drift away.
Scatter, fade, turn to foam.
Do you not remember me?
After all, I am the heavy burden you must bear...
How could I be so easily forsaken?
Dan... Feng?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Is this another Memosnatcher trick?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Vidyadhara are supposed to forget the past during hatching rebirth, but the Preceptors interfered back then and allowed "me" to remain deep in your consciousness.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: If you do not wish to use that bloodstained name, you may call me "Obliviated Memory."
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: ...That's not necessary. Though we've long parted ways, I won't ever forget you.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: So, who is that giant?
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: That is Amphoreus's "Earth" demigod. He should be on our side, but he was led astray and intends to seize the power of dragon transmutation.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The dragon descends upon the earth, and all beings look to it in reverence. You and I know that all life in the universe covets Permanence.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Are you trying to say I'll end up like you?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: One day you will, and as I see it, that day won't be far from the end of this journey.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Let's move on to another topic. I have no intention of passing judgment on "Dan Feng," and I have even less desire to become entangled with him again.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I only have one concern right now: bringing my companions back safely.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I remember this scene...
Here we are again... after so long.
You can either help me deal with these abominations or return to the shadows of memory, Dan Feng.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Alright. The filthy remnants of the memoria tide still run rampant. Let me accompany you through these ruins. You could use the help.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: And presumably, that giant who craves the power of dragons won't just let things rest.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Do as you please. I'm moving ahead.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Phew, it's all good now. {RUBY_B#Passage Titan}Janus{RUBY_E#}'s blessing is full, and the Hidden Passage can be used again!
rows.speaker: "Trianne"

rows.text: Now, the Imperator's legions can launch a surprise attack from the Grove.
rows.speaker: "Trinnon"

rows.text: The Harmony is dangerous.
I noticed it back at the hotel.
Who knows if Terravox will be able to succeed...
rows.speaker: "Tribbie"

rows.text: (What's this...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: (Memories... from before I woke up?)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...So, Silver Wolf, how long till {F#s}he wakes?
rows.speaker: Kafka

rows.text: Huh? Who is this warrior?
rows.speaker: "Tribbie"

rows.text: Lady Tribios, I am Dan Heng, [Trailblazer]'s companion.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Dan Heng? Nice to meet you. I didn't realize [Trailblazer] had more companions in addition to little Cyrene.
rows.speaker: "Trinnon"

rows.text: There is no need to elaborate further. They are merely a collection of your memories, just like me.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: No. If they were my memories, they would recognize me.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Dan... Dan Heng?
rows.speaker: "Trianne"

rows.text: Even though we don't know you, we'll still ask you to get somewhere safe. A terrible battle is about to break out here.
rows.speaker: "Trianne"

rows.text: Hysilens... I mean, "Dux Gladiorum" is not far ahead. The evacuation efforts are almost over, so go now, or it might be too late.
rows.speaker: "Trinnon"

rows.text: Hysilens...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I see. In that case, I'll go look for her now. Thank you.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: No problem! We need to go deliver some messages, so we'll be off. Please take care, Dan Heng!
rows.speaker: "Tribbie"

rows.text: Memory's crazed ramblings. What do you think?
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: It's too early to reach a conclusion, but this memory is most definitely not mine.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: There are two possibilities: This memory either belongs to Terravox, or it belongs to [Trailblazer], the person you're desperately looking for.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: But the probability of the latter is very low.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Correct, but the conversation I just had gave me an idea.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Let's forget "Evernight" for now. In the Vortex of Genesis, there was someone else who went missing along with [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I still have a chance to make contact with her.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: And the way I'll do it... is right here in the Grove.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: N—No! Stay back, you cursed beast...
rows.speaker: Desperate Soldier

rows.text: Hehehe! Look who it is! It's the water-splashing poser! Didn't think I'd catch you here!
rows.speaker: Bartholos

rows.text: Are you... the Spirithief? Bartholos?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Never mind, best not to tempt fate. Get ready, {F#s}he's about to wake up.
rows.speaker: Silver Wolf

rows.text: Yes, Madam Herta. I've made contact with {M#him.}{F#her.}
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Understood. I'll carry out my part as expected...
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Quite the dazzling nest you have, little bird of the Harmony."
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Ugh...!
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: "Your grasp of memoria is unexpectedly profound. But playtime's over."
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: "This ocean we created according to her wish... this journey that flows on without end..."
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: "Don't any of you think about interfering with it."
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: She's coming... Is it me she's after this time?
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: [Trailblazer], there's no time to regroup! I've prepared an alternate escape route!
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: Wake from your slumber... and return to reality.
rows.speaker: Sunday

rows.text: While Evernight was stopping Sunday, Cyrene, who remained in [Trailblazer]'s memory world, made a discovery...
You can't get past this.
rows.speaker: Bartholos

rows.text: I see. Thank you for the advice. My cloudhymn magic will take it from here.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Save your energy for more important stuff! This is a piece of cake. Leave it to yours truly!
rows.speaker: Bartholos

rows.text: It's all because of that crazy lady with pink hair and red eyes! In order to stop her from monitoring me, I sealed my voice, hehehe!
rows.speaker: Bartholos

rows.text: There are plenty of ways to get through here. Hehehe, it's time for me to show you what I can do!
rows.speaker: Bartholos

rows.text: The water problem is now all gone! Go take the elevator over there if you want to keep going.
rows.speaker: Bartholos

rows.text: We're here. Now it's time to awaken the person we're looking for.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: A pool of spirit water...
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: I see. You plan to resonate with the waters of this world.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Compared to the currents of my home, the waters of Amphoreus are... rather untamed. Subduing the waters wasn't easy, but I've gotten the hang of it now.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "Under the raucous steps of their frenzied dance, the roar of celebration..."
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "...Calls forth the spirit water's memories."
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: How incredible...
There are still survivors in Amphoreus, and this one even knows how to use the arts of water.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Very good...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It's nice to meet the "Ocean" demigod, Lady Hysilens.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: A green dragonfish... Are you Dan Heng? I hope I've remembered your name correctly.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Scalegorge Waterscape is your home, isn't it? In [Trailblazer]'s memories, I saw you two standing side-by-side.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: That's fortunate. It means I won't have to introduce myself. I can get straight to the point.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Tell me, where are "Evernight" and [Trailblazer]?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You must be careful. "Earth" has abandoned the Flame-Chase mission. Though Terravox still lives, they are not an ally of the Trailblaze.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: That's no surprise. I've already exchanged blows with that mad demigod.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I didn't think... the worst would still come to pass.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: He also intends to get his hands on a {RUBY_B#the power of Permanence}dangerous power{RUBY_E#}. As his comrade-in-arms, do you know what his goal is?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Terravox has only ever cared for life born from this soil. If they covet powers from beyond the sky, I suppose it's out of the same care.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Even so, their behavior is... far too unusual.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: I presume they wouldn't have made such a drastic and irreversible decision if they had not exhausted all other means.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Hehehe, once again, it's my turn to show you what I can do!
rows.speaker: Bartholos

rows.text: I'm counting on you then.
Just a minute.
Prepare to witness the Great Bartholos's heroic deeds, poser boy!
rows.speaker: Bartholos

rows.text: But embracing the Permanence may result in even more misfortune.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: While I admire that demigod's willpower, my position has not changed.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It seems that if I want to find "Evernight," I will have to confront Earth. Since my opponent has already turned into a vicious beast...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What I do won't weigh on my conscience.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...Then allow my specter to accompany you, Lord Dan Heng. As the demigod who witnessed the end of this world...
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: At least let me sing an elegy for my last comrade.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: That doesn't sound like something you would normally say.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: "What I do won't weigh on my conscience." I can certainly guess what you mean by that.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: I will never hesitate for my companions.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Lord Terravox, where are you?
Lord Terravox has betrayed us...
I am a Nameless, and what I'm going to do...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Is to defend all the hopes that are on the verge of fading away.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Then I misspoke.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: That is exactly how the "guard" of the Astral Express should act.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: █ █You are me██are█us█ ██ ██
rows.speaker: "Tribbie" (?)

rows.text: ███From█ █permanence██gain█eternal life█ █
rows.speaker: "Anaxa" (?)

rows.text: █Throw yourself into █the █forge████ █ █
rows.speaker: "Mydei" (?)

rows.text: █Merge██ █as█one███ █ █
rows.speaker: "Castorice" (?)

rows.text: ███Keep going█keep█going██ █ █going█ █
rows.speaker: "Hyacine" (?)

rows.text: ███Do not█run from██ █ your█fate█ █
rows.speaker: "Cipher" (?)

rows.text: ██Use the Permanence█to fill██the█"Earth" ███ ██
rows.speaker: "Phainon" (?)

rows.text: Vidyadhara might not even be considered people if we did not resort to beastly actions!
rows.speaker: "Taoran" (?)

rows.text: Why did Dan Feng choose me all those years ago?
rows.speaker: "Bailu" (?)

rows.text: Long's Scion... fall into oblivion!
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: The memoria tide surges violently. Hold on, and don't let your focus be swept away.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Of five people...
rows.speaker: "Jingliu" (?)

rows.text: Three must pay a price...
rows.speaker: "Jing Yuan" (?)

rows.text: Hehehe, no big deal — barely lifted a finger!
rows.speaker: Bartholos

rows.text: "Trickery" will always find a way, {F#girl}{M#boy}!
rows.speaker: Bartholos

rows.text: You... are one of them.
rows.speaker: "Blade" (?)

rows.text: It's unusually quiet here compared to before.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Don't let your guard down. The memoria tide has become even more violent...
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Is that...
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: ...Your mind retains far more of the past than I had imagined.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: I've seen this farewell more than once in my dreams.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The previous life is just an immersia to a newly-born Vidyadhara. You know rationally that these are "your" memories, but it doesn't feel like you experienced them yourself.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: I used dragon transmutation for selfish reasons, and close friends turned to enemies.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: You probably want to ask me if it was worth it.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: The Military Affairs Office is placing more importance on the Yuque's battle this time, and the Yaoqing called her back for a patrol mission.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Some people are born with adventure in their blood and can't stop for even a moment. No matter, I'll drink her portion for her!
rows.speaker: Yingxing

rows.text: We're already toasting? Why don't we wait for Dan Feng?
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: As always, the high elder has endless meetings with the Preceptors that he can't get away from. Let's not wait on him.
rows.speaker: Yingxing

rows.text: Pah... Isn't this just water!?
rows.speaker: Yingxing

rows.text: I'll relay her exact words: It is a mistake to drink too much before a battle, so I'll leave a jar of spring water from Thalassa's crystal palace.
rows.speaker: Jingliu

rows.text: She said that wine only has flavor after a triumphant return.
rows.speaker: Jingliu

rows.text: ...Why didn't you say so earlier?
rows.speaker: Yingxing

rows.text: I didn't want to go along with her, but she insisted on seeing your expression after your first sip.
rows.speaker: Jingliu

rows.text: Any gift from a friend, whether it is water or wine, is rich in flavor all the same.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: I see you still speak as if every sentence must add something of profound value.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: I see you still speak as if every sentence must add something of profound value.
rows.speaker: Dan Feng

rows.text: You're just in time! The punishment for making us all wait should be three cups of wine.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Spare me, please. I've already suffered enough next to the ancient sea.
rows.speaker: Dan Feng

rows.text: I've convinced the Preceptors: Vidyadhara cloudhymn magi will join the battle on the frontlines, and our armies will fight side-by-side.
rows.speaker: Dan Feng

rows.text: It seems like you can now carry out your plan for dealing with the "Ketu Mirage," Jing Yuan.
rows.speaker: Yingxing

rows.text: Thank you for standing your ground against the dissenters, Dan Feng.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: I never thought those Preceptors would ever relent. After all of this, countless Vidyadhara...
rows.speaker: Yingxing

rows.text: Countless Vidyadhara will lose their lives, with no chance at a molting rebirth. We all understand this.
rows.speaker: Dan Feng

rows.text: But the Vidyadhara cannot become a part of the Alliance's destiny if we do not share in its joys and sorrows. We would only be bystanders to everyone else's suffering.
rows.speaker: Dan Feng

rows.text: That is something we all understand as well.
rows.speaker: Jingliu

rows.text: That is also why we've gathered here. Come, raise your cups. This toast is not for bidding farewell to each other...
rows.speaker: Jingliu

rows.text: But for honoring the soldiers who will not return, for honoring our companions.
rows.speaker: Jingliu

rows.text: Apologies, my reckless plan must have put a lot of pressure on you.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: Nonsense.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: If our positions were flipped, you'd support me no matter how reckless my plan was, right?
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Of course. But let's try not to be too reckless.
rows.speaker: Jing Yuan

rows.text: When you make a decision like this, people will always ask, "Was it worth it?"... And you will also forever question yourself.
rows.speaker: Jingliu

rows.text: You should know better than I do. After that final battle, even the First Genius couldn't determine where {F#s}he went.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Do you know how you will answer that question?
rows.speaker: Jingliu

rows.text: I won't answer it. I will prove it.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: That's right. My sword is my answer.
rows.speaker: Jingliu

rows.text: Thank you, Dan Feng! Thank you, Jing Yuan! Thank you, Jingliu! And thank you, Baiheng, wherever you've run off to!
rows.speaker: Yingxing

rows.text: Ridiculous, how did you get drunk from spring water?
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Hmph, I'm just full of joy! It feels like I've just forged a divine weapon with masterful craftsmanship!
rows.speaker: Yingxing

rows.text: "I'd rather leave this world in a blaze than live until the end of time..." That's what I always firmly believed in the past. But I never truly felt like I was alive until I met all of you.
rows.speaker: Yingxing

rows.text: Now I wish more than anything that I could just live a bit longer. No, pretend I didn't say that!
rows.speaker: Yingxing

rows.text: It's over.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: And you know exactly what happened to these five afterward.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: So, can you understand it now, after both [Trailblazer] and March 7th have left you?
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Losing a dear friend with whom you've shared so much can never be considered a victory. It's a failure that torments you for the rest of your life. I could never accept that kind of fate.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: So you made a decision.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I was the one who used the Transmutation Arcanum. I was the one who swore to bring Baiheng back to life.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: And the one who brought everything past the point of no return... that was also me.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Do you have any regrets, Dan Feng?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Even if I could reverse time, I would not choose differently.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: And if it had been Jingliu, Jing Yuan... or even Yingxing who died in battle, I'd still choose to do the same thing.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: The stranger snatched away the "Deliverer" right before my eyes. I commanded the waters to surge after them, but layered cliffs blocked the water's current...
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Because only I could make that choice and protect all of this. Now, for the sake of your companions, for the sake of those two who walk alongside you...
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: How much are you willing to sacrifice, Dan Heng?
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Everything.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Your answer does not surprise me.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Then let me see how you'll carry out your convictions.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Let's leave this place and go settle things with that mad demigod.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Terravox has already defected! Legions, charge with me!
rows.speaker: "Dux Fragoris" Labienus

rows.text: Hah, a beast will always be a beast.
rows.speaker: "Dux Brumalis" Seneca

rows.text: This campaign has been far too cruel...
rows.speaker: "Dux Carminum" Verginia

rows.text: Let them be a necessary sacrifice for the Flame-Chase.
rows.speaker: "Dux Helkolithist" Apollonius

rows.text: Seismic Walking Dragon, history shall remember you as a titan-slayer!
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: Memories intersect. Another betrayal, another catastrophe.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Regardless of whose memory this is, it seems that Terravox has a leading role in it.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: A beast that's been "rebelling" its whole life... No wonder they descended into madness.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Huh?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: As expected, someone's been waiting for us.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: It's you...?
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: They are here...
A Scion of Permanence... and your old comrade-in-arms.
Terravox, my old friend... Indulge yourself.
Let this memoria tide swallow everything.
Be prepared for the worst, Lord Dan Heng. This Mountain Dweller must not be underestimated...
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Geocles the Mountainbreaker... Earth's Dromas Rider, it's been a while.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: "Mountainbreaker"? He's... not Terravox?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I remember you, little fish, and your despicable master.
rows.speaker: Geocles the Mountainbreaker

rows.text: I didn't think you were still alive.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Death is just a return to the Earth for Mountain Dwellers. Thanks to Evernight's gift...
rows.speaker: Geocles the Mountainbreaker

rows.text: I was able to come back to the mortal realm and keep watch over my dear friend, the "Earth" demigod who was sacrificed to the Flame-Chase plot in vain.
rows.speaker: Geocles the Mountainbreaker

rows.text: Long's Scion, you are the most important offering in this ritual sacrifice. No matter how strong your will is, it will eventually be swallowed by the memoria tide. When that time comes, you and {RUBY_B#Transmutation Arcanum}the powers you bear{RUBY_E#} will serve us...
rows.speaker: Geocles the Mountainbreaker

rows.text: We will use the Permanence to awaken the fallen Giant Dragon and give the "Earth" an everlasting body!
rows.speaker: Geocles the Mountainbreaker

rows.text: I see. So you pretended to be Terravox...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: In order to lead us here into a trap.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: If it weren't for the Imperator's tricks, the name "Terravox" would be shared between us anyway.
rows.speaker: Geocles the Mountainbreaker

rows.text: They made the right choice for Amphoreus's tomorrow.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: But the tomorrow you speak of only ever had a place for "humans."
rows.speaker: Geocles the Mountainbreaker

rows.text: Watch, my old friend...
rows.speaker: Geocles the Mountainbreaker

rows.text: I will once again start a fire that burns away the chains that shackle us!
rows.speaker: Geocles the Mountainbreaker

rows.text: Why don't you leave this to me, Lord Dan Heng? Use that Hidden Passage to reach the opposite shore. Perhaps [Trailblazer] is there, deeper inside...
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: No, I will stay here.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "Mountainbreaker," hero of the Mountain Dwellers. If I do not stay here and triumph over him, he will die an ugly death in delusions of the Permanence. That should not be his destiny.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: And for the vicious beast that insists on obstructing the Astral Express and threatening the fate of the world...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: We've stood on the precipice countless times along this journey, forced to make difficult choices in the face of disaster. But this time...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It's my turn to put some pressure on this world.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It's time to stop struggling, Geocles. Go to your death with dignity.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Before that, tell me, what kind of deal did you make with Evernight? How was the great Mountainbreaker reduced to this?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: *bereaved roar*
That's...
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Leave it to me. I'll recount the Earth's heaviest past...
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: ...And sever its deepest delusion.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: Terravox... Is that you?
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Your body... has become so frail.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Even mountain ranges grow old and eventually die.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: But I can hear the sound of blood still surging through your veins, fast and strong...
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: I suppose you are the true Earth demigod.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I am near my end, and the demigod title means nothing to me now. The being who stands here now is just the former comrade of the "Mountainbreaker"...
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: And the traitor who abandoned him.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: Traitor?
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Terravox was once a member of Geocles' Dromas Legion. This force was famous for its skilled riders and their brave dromases.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Terravox themself was the Dromas King, the Giant Dragon who swore their life to the "Mountainbreaker."
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: In the battle against {RUBY_B#Earth Titan}Georios{RUBY_E#}, the Imperator could not surmount this mountain and thus had to break it from the inside. Terravox's betrayal was key to the Flame-Chase Army's victory.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: The age of the gods was coming to an end. Living beings had adapted to the changes amidst the rifts of the earth, and now they had to learn to survive in the crevices of the epics.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: Someone had to watch over the "Earth." So I agreed to a deal. I would take the Titan's divine authority and sink into the cliffs, using my flesh and blood forged of stone to mend the land. But...
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: There was one "betrayal" I could never forget.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: The "Mountainbreaker"... refused to believe that was my choice, even till his dying breath. Faced with having to surrender to the Imperator, he chose to die instead.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: So this is why you decided to conspire with "Evernight."
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: "Time's" strange visitor appeared before me. The great power from beyond the sky called the Remembrance... It's incredible.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: Geocles was able to be reborn as a "memosprite." He mumbled about the times we fought side by side, just like how all the {RUBY_B#memories}lives{RUBY_E#} this body carries speak to me.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: "Evernight" did not ask for much in return. She only wished for me to use the divine authority of "Earth" to hide her tracks.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: Since you're being so candid, does this mean... you've given up resisting?
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Hah, resistance...
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: For a beast on the brink of death, what is the point of resistance?
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: I see... A thousand years have passed, and your mind has long since been shattered.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: This frail body bears the weight of all those I've betrayed, and now, my only wish is to rest with them...
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: In the unchanging past.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: Go, Long's Scion. That fiery blaze has already burned through "Earth's" protection, revealing the secrets underneath...
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: The deepest depths in Amphoreus. The great tomb where all the past is buried.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: The one you seek, "Evernight," walked out of that place. Before her arrival, no one knew of its existence.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: In other words, that is the place where "Evernight" came into being...
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: And it is also where she is now.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: You sank willingly into the past, and now your "memories" have turned into this form... Was it worth it?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: At least I still remember.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: As long as I never forget, they will live on.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: Primitive and animalistic... I understand these instincts.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Have you ever regretted anything?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The earth is not a lonely island in the middle of the ocean. It is the sum of all the living things that stand on it.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: I have never regretted defending the creatures of this world.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: Then, a final question...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Terravox... After all this, how much are you willing to sacrifice for the power of the Permanence?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Everything.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: My journey up to here has allowed me to fully understand my destiny: No matter how I struggle, the "Earth" will never be able to reach the stars.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: But my compatriots deserve to continue their struggle. At the end of my life, I want to make one last effort to give them a chance to move on to the future...
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: Even if it is a future I am not able to witness.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: Then free what remains of my body and let me give you this flame that turned away from the Flame-Chase—
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: I now relinquish my duty as a demigod.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: "You shall dig your own grave and burn in the furnace of rebellion"...
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: I only hope that, after all this time, {RUBY_B#Earth Titan}Father{RUBY_E#} will take me back into their heart.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: Come, crouching beast! For the endless life of this world...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Rise from your dormancy, and follow me as soaring dragons of the wilderness!
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Fortunately...
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: The worst did not come to pass.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: If your opponent had already turned into a vicious beast, whatever you did wouldn't weigh on your conscience... So what if that demigod had harbored ill intentions or vowed to fight to the death...
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Would you have pointed your spear at them and carved out the Coreflame with your own hands?
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: There's no point in discussing "what-ifs," though I am glad it didn't come to that.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Regardless, I will attempt to join this game and become a part of the Era Nova.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This is the only way I can face my friends and this world with a "clear conscience."
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Hah...
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Now that things are settled between us, it's time for you and I to say goodbye.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Everything that I left behind has {RUBY_B#become the power of the Permanence}faded away{RUBY_E#} at this point. Go and march toward your own "Permanence."
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: As for how to tame it... I'll leave that to you.
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Thank you. We can't go back to the past and make better choices. But at least we can do better in the future.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: A dragon can only welcome new life by shedding away his old, scarred skin...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: For the first time in my life, I feel at ease.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This burning Coreflame... Is this what the Destruction feels like?
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: The light is unexpectedly warm... It's just like...
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: The fleeting moments... when one wakes from a dream...
rows.speaker: "Dan Feng"

rows.text: Farewell, Dan Feng...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Now... it's time for me to set out once more.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The final rebellion of "Earth" was to bestow Trailblazing wings upon all living beings...
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: For Terravox, this was probably the best possible ending.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Behind that scar lies what they called the "deepest depths." The rising steam tells me that [Trailblazer] is in there...
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: I'm afraid I can't tell.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: A scorching abyss... If I were to enter it alone, I'd almost certainly get lost.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Miss Hysilens, would you give me cover? I'll need to focus completely on what's ahead and may not be able to pay attention to my surroundings.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: What are you planning to do?
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: I'm going to continue where you left off.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Times have changed... The cliffs... are now in the palm of my hand.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Then I believe it's worth a shot.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: It's just... without absolute resolve, you still won't be able to pass through that memoria tide, much less save someone from it.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: The search for [Trailblazer] might stretch on like an evernight without end... Be careful. Wandering through "Time" is no easy feat.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: I understand. Then...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Join me in rebelling against this unjust fate once more.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Even if the world collapses, the "Earth" must remain unshaken.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Give me the Coreflame that burns within you, and allow this immortal body of the Permanence to bear the furnace of life for you.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Long's Scion... Are you willing to bring them all into the new world?
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: I won't give you empty promises. Allow me to answer your question from a different perspective.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The Permanence is the path that dragons trod, and "eternity" is life's deepest desire. If you entrust the earth's living beings to me, they will live in symbiosis with the instincts in my blood.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: With this body as an ark, I will deliver them to tomorrow for you. That tomorrow won't be the end of Amphoreus's west wind...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: But a vast and boundless sea of stars.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: A sea of stars...
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: It's a future where all beings can Trailblaze side by side, not a prison made from Remembrance.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: In the Veil of Evernight's memories, you've always... been someone with reservations.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: Hah, I misjudged your resolve. I understand... This is the only choice.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: Behold, this Coreflame that burns in my chest. This Coreflame born from the "Earth." It is the redsoil from which life sprouts, and the furnace of all living things...
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: It tells me to commit one final act of treason: Entrust this heavy task to the Trailblazers from beyond the sky. Let them tend to the wild terrain and safeguard the lands...
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: And thus bring the endless stream of life into the distant future.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: I promise you, Terravox.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Good. When I hand over the divine authority, this place will fall to pieces.
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: Are you prepared to hold up the Sacred Tree if it falls?
rows.speaker: Terravox

rows.text: Of course.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Don't worry, Lady Hysilens. Just as you kept your lonely vigil in the depths for a thousand years, my determination to find [Trailblazer]...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Is even more unshakeable than the "Earth" itself.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Ancient Sacred Tree, lend me your roots. With the Coreflame I carry, let me resonate with this land.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: With heaven and earth as my map and time as my compass, I will find {RUBY_B#you, asleep among memoria tide}that one singular point{RUBY_E#}.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Even if I must cross every mountain and valley on my own two feet...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I will bring you home.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Finally...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I've found you, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It really has... been a long time.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Don't be so sentimental. That's not like you.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Long time no see. Did you... get taller?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Dan Heng, I knew... you would come back.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Thankfully, "Evernight" did not try to stop me. Looks like we've managed to stay ahead of her this time.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: We must save March 7th.
What about Cyrene? Where is she?
How's the Express Crew doing?
She was everywhere in the memoria tide...
Rest assured, we won't abandon her. We'll all return to the Express together... No one will be left behind.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: You mean "Mem"? Sorry, I haven't seen her at all on this journey. Perhaps you were not the only one being held captive by "Evernight."
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: They never once stopped worrying about us, about you, me, or March 7th. They never gave up on trying to save us, even from outside this world.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Miss Himeko, Mr. Yang, Pom-Pom, and even Sunday, Black Swan, and the two geniuses... They are all doing everything in their power to aid us.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I understand. Her power... shouldn't be underestimated.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: But right now, {F#s}he's trapped in a bottomless whirlpool.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Is "Evernight" with {M#him?}{F#her?}
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It was only when I personally stepped into the maze of "Time" that it suddenly struck me... She and I had crossed paths once before.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I'll only warn you once. Leave her body. Now.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I feel like I've seen these floating black things somewhere before...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I had an unexpected encounter with her when I left Amphoreus. Perhaps to avoid exposing her whereabouts, she stripped that memory from my mind.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: That power called "Oblivion"... it's just like an Emanator's.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The stranger snatched away the "Deliverer" right before my eyes. I commanded the waters to surge after them, but layered cliffs blocked the water's current...
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: (Oblivion...)
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: I know. But you still remember me and our companions for now.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Do you have any clues about the memories you may have lost?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Nothing seems out of the ordinary...
"Mere mortals. Flawed individuals. Failed heroes..."
If I'm not mistaken, Evernight's plan is to make you forget Amphoreus, including the Chrysos Heirs who have journeyed with us up till now.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Are those "Evernight's" exact words? If I'm not mistaken, she intends to make you forget Amphoreus, including the Chrysos Heirs who have journeyed with us up till now.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: But it seems you still recognize Lady Hysilens.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: If I made that much of an impression on Little Gray Fry, then I am naturally delighted.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: But I fear your escape from that power they call "Oblivion"...
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Is thanks to someone else.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Nice to meet you, or... maybe I should ask, how have you been since we last saw each other?
rows.speaker: "Castorice"

rows.text: Along with you, this little butterflyfish's memory was also salvaged from the depths of that whirlpool.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Just as a pearl is cradled within its shell... the power of Thanatos surrounds you, shielding your soul from corrosion.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Miss Cyrene has spoken of you often to me, [Trailblazer]. Though we never met in this life, I believe... there's a kind of warmth that can transcend time itself.
rows.speaker: "Castorice"

rows.text: Through the endless flow of time, I guarded the secret passage between Styxia and the Vortex. When the memoria tide flowed backwards into the River of Souls, even in deep slumber, I could feel that warmth...
rows.speaker: "Castorice"

rows.text: And with all my might, I protected that warmth.
rows.speaker: "Castorice"

rows.text: I apologize if that seemed improper. I hope you'll forgive me.
rows.speaker: "Castorice"

rows.text: She was just speaking metaphorically... This conversation feels familiar somehow.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Haha...
rows.speaker: "Castorice"

rows.text: What...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I understand that your mission is still unfinished. The path ahead is treacherous, and even though my body is bound to these dark currents, I'll do everything I can to watch over you both.
rows.speaker: "Castorice"

rows.text: The little butterflyfish is right. There is still {RUBY_B#Zandar}a pair of eyes{RUBY_E#} watching from the shadows, but we won't let them get anywhere near you.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Go forth, golden dragonfish, and you, "Deliverer," seek out your companion...
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Go forth and illuminate the lightless "Evernight."
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: I cannot thank you enough. Accept this promise from the Nameless: Amphoreus will definitely write a brand-new ending for itself.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Of course, we'll write it together.
rows.speaker: "Castorice"

rows.text: The Nameless will never stop...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Until all of us stand side by side in the true new world.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Farewell, Little Fry.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Hehe... You still remember how much I love fire and feasts. All right then, it's a promise. Go find your companion and see your journey through.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: When we reunite in the ocean at the boundaries of this world, let me play a song for you beneath the glow of fire.
rows.speaker: "Hysilens"

rows.text: Goodbye, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: "Castorice"

rows.text: As Lady Trinnon used to say, fate is not the flowers that bloom at the end of the road, but where people tread beyond the gate...
rows.speaker: "Castorice"

rows.text: Take all beautiful wishes with you, march forward with determination, and don't look back.
rows.speaker: "Castorice"

rows.text: Phainon is still fighting against the Destruction. Hysilens and Castorice remain on watch, guarding the path that led us here.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Only by moving forward can we honor the efforts of all Chrysos Heirs.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This place was once Mnestia's altar...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Could the golden thread be leading us to the world's deepest secret?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Naturally. How could a world enclosed within the scepter have a way of knowing what it looks like from outer space?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Where was it? Can you remember?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: "Overthrow the gods— / Restore the Coreflames—"
rows.speaker: Dying Titan

rows.text: Which Titan is this?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It's very similar, yet somewhat different.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: That doesn't make sense. How could a world enclosed within the scepter have a way of knowing what it looks like from outer space?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Unless... the mural isn't a drawing of Amphoreus... but rather someone saw the mural and shaped the world in its image?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Could that someone be "Zandar"?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: ...No. His concession proves that this place where "Evernight" is hiding must be a blind spot of the experiment.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: I'm afraid not even "Zandar" knows about the existence of this great tomb, or the secrets buried within it.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Finally, we've found his weakness.
Did his creation go out of control again?
He's using me to dig up these secrets.
Best to not get carried away. For something to be hidden even from him, it must either be extraordinary... or unimaginably dangerous.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It's hard to tell right now, but this definitely isn't the outcome he wants to see. For something to be hidden even from him, it must be either extraordinary... or unimaginably dangerous.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: He must be calculating something. But this time, with the Chrysos Heirs giving us their full support, we've had the upper hand from the start.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This forbidden realm remains undetectable to "Zandar," and even Phainon's strike merely opened the entrance, yet "Evernight" can freely swim through it as she pleases...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It cannot be reached by the Erudition, nor can it be erased by the Destruction...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Be careful. What lies dormant beneath may well be Amphoreus's final Path — Remembrance.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: It's endless... It feels like we're plunging into an abyss...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Are those distant structures... all entombed data?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Ready, [Trailblazer]? Once we step inside, I'm afraid there'll be no turning back.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: This maze is full of... memory loss...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Your voice sounds different from usual. I only hear a hint of curiosity...
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: The rest is all fear, beautiful Memokeeper.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: I know exactly where that fear comes from. The "evernight" is a memetic entity's natural nemesis... They will swallow you whole with just a flick of my pinky finger.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: I am the Garden's enemy. I have never denied that fact.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: I have to say, Miss Evernight... you've certainly got a unique way of "protecting" people.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: (At least she's still willing to talk. Is it because I disobeyed the Garden's rules? Maybe I still have a chance...)
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: They are more than just my companions. They are the path I took that led me to where I am now.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: So they will also be beacons for when I am lost, leading me to the future, until my next "reincarnation."
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: No.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: I don't think you do.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: ...It's not very elegant to spy on someone's thoughts, you know.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Well, before you get rid of this "beautiful Memokeeper," the least you could do is answer some of my questions.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Why should I do that? So you can buy more time and send a message to your companions?
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: And here I thought you were already watching my companions' every move.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: I am. Earth's stirrings have ceased. They have defeated Terravox and are heading here as we speak.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Don't tell me that's a part of your plan, too.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: It's not, but I'll make good use of it. Fighting alone against an entire world, even I might miss something. But I know how to adapt to the circumstances.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Just like right now, how I've decided to let you go. I like you, little bird. Your longing for "memories" remains pure... unlike those Memosnatchers.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Your most precious quality is how you've yet to be tainted by the Garden's dark side.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: A golden light that can destroy the world pierces through the sky, the Sacred Tree, and the mountains. Looking from where you are, you see that the light behind that scar burns still.
I'll take that as a compliment.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: But I still don't understand why you've kidnapped me here.
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Well, seeing is believing, so why don't we take a stroll together?
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Let's go! For March 7th.
Let's go and save this world.
Let's wait for a moment...
March 7th is surely waiting to see us again.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Let's go! On the Trailblaze, no one gets left behind!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: For March 7th, and for Amphoreus...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Let's go! On the Trailblaze, no one gets left behind!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: This is important, so make sure you're fully prepared. I'll be waiting for you, [Trailblazer].
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: If her departure was part of the cycle, then perhaps in every reincarnation, Castorice would take care of this pristine soul.
But she chose to break free from the cycle. The 'soul' will not journey to where the west wind ends, but will descend into the Great Tomb, to carry on hope.
This ruin buried deep underground is called the "kernel" in the language of Erudition, but I gave it a friendlier name...
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: The heart of Amphoreus, the great tomb of the nameless Titan.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: The nameless Titan...?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: You'll see with your own eyes just how important the Remembrance has been in this world...
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: And how we will stir up the waves of "Oblivion" to douse an Aeon's ambition. ♭
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: You've been hiding here all this time?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: That's right. Curious about how I discovered this place?
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: It's not actually all that complicated. The road we just walked was the beginning of March 7th's "journey in Amphoreus."
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: The beginning?
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: Do you still remember how Three Paths are said to intertwine in Amphoreus? That three entities, each comparable to an Emanator, left their marks in this world?
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: There's Zandar, Irontomb, and...
rows.speaker: Black Swan

rows.text: That's right. To this day, there have been no signs of the entity corresponding to the Remembrance.
