rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: ...I'm against including this photo, but suit yourself. I just think that a travel journal should mainly focus on documenting local customs and culture.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Okhema, Castrum Kremnos, the Grove... these shots are all pretty great. I have to say, your skills are almost on par with March's now.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: That's how awesome I am! Oh right, how about this one: The {RUBY_B#Time Titan}Veil of Evernight, Oronyx{RUBY_E#}, the Titan lurking behind the mist... Pretty epic, right?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Is that actual mist... or just motion blur from your shaky hands?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Hey, that was a super tense moment! I only had the chance to take a quick one. We're lucky to have anything at all!
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Huh...?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Did you... hear something?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Don't try to trick me with that trolley problem.
...March 7th?
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Perhaps the photo captured a trace of Time's divine power, which replayed echoes from your memories.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: Uh... alright then. Let's keep going...
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Wait!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Cyrene?
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Another "damsel-in-distress rescue"... plays out again!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Still think you can do something, little pink memosprite?
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: What weapons do you have to stand against me besides your somewhat witty words?
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Don't underestimate me! Besides my charm and eloquence I can—
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: If March were here, she'd definitely have plenty of great ideas.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: What...?
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: We don't have time for endless chatter at crucial moments like this!
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Hmm...
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: They went back and forth like that, discussing for hours.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: It was like they were arguing about which game to play, how to sneak midnight snacks from the dining car without Pom-Pom noticing, or who was gonna wash Miss Himeko's coffee cup, just like every other night on the Express.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: They've always been by my side. No one knows about my forgotten past, but no one holds it against me. That's because...
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: We can't go back to the past and make better choices.
rows.speaker: Dan Heng

rows.text: The Memosnatcher gave no response. It was like a corpse, drowned in a deep-sea shipwreck, drifting slowly and completely empty.
The Memosnatcher gave no response. It was like a deflated balloon that had been completely hollowed out, floating motionless at an unremarkable height.
But at least we can do better in the future.
rows.speaker: [Trailblazer]

rows.text: Isn't that right?
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: I still remember the day when you first put on these clothes and looked in the mirror.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Your eyes were so clear. When all this is over, I hope the mirror can still reflect those same eyes.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: You're pretty naive, too. Always hoping that the mirror will show the most beautiful side...
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: But you don't even trust the you reflected in the mirror, and if you keep trying to shoulder everything for me... then I'll actually end up as a wallflower, waiting forever for my turn!
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: Yes. I get it, March 7th.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: I only have "your" memories, and you... have always been the "me" that I wanted the world to see.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Just hearing those words from you makes me feel super satisfied.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: Well, I've appealed to your emotions. As for reasoning with logic...
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: Could you help us out here, Cyrene?
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: I'm here~ Finally my turn to shine, isn't it?
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Miss Evernight, you've been so fixated on your target that you probably haven't even realized...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: That a massive variable has emerged in Amphoreus in this cycle.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Amphoreus is about to be destroyed. There's no time left for pointless debates.
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: There is only one law I want to overturn to aid the final battle of deliverance, so I will only offer the life of one demigod...
rows.speaker: Cerydra

rows.text: The Imperator added one extra rule to the final Era Nova at the cost of her life. That's how she can ensure Amphoreus doesn't become a sacrifice in the cosmic conflict.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: Even if this world has to exist in the form of Irontomb, it will stand on its own among the stars, just as she had wanted.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: ...Oh? Interesting. What does she want to do?
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Simple. "If any anomaly occurs during the Era Nova process, all foreign elements will be eliminated immediately — whether it's the Remembrance or the Trailblaze — and the twelve Coreflames will complete the final Era Nova through the purest form of Destruction."
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: A daring wager indeed... That ruthless Imperator. Could she have already sensed that the Remembrance was plotting in the shadows?
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: No. You managed to fool everyone. There's no way she could have known your plan. Modifying this law was just a precaution, to prevent the Astral Express and the geniuses from betraying Amphoreus after her downfall.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: But if you insist on doing this right now, then the cosmos will undoubtedly face the worst possible outcome...
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: [Trailblazer], Dan Heng, and March 7th will all merge with the Scepter and become a victim of the Destruction.
rows.speaker: Cyrene

rows.text: You... knew all along?
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Yep. But I decided I needed to have a heart-to-heart with you first.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: I won't be afraid, even if my inner world is nothing but an "evernight."
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: That's because my journey's destination lies among the stars. I believe what lies ahead will be bright enough to illuminate my past.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: Thank you for your... coddling, but please trust me and leave it to me. Both my past and that obsessive "Oblivion"....
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: Will help me become even stronger than [Trailblazer] and Dan Heng!
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: I'm sorry for becoming an obstacle in your journey.
rows.speaker: "Evernight"

rows.text: Don't apologize, Evernight.
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: We're just two sides reflected by the same mirror, aren't we?
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: So when we bid farewell to our division and become one...
rows.speaker: "March 7th"

rows.text: Our "memories" will only grow more beautiful.
rows.speaker: March 7th
